اعتصبوا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَصَبُوا (iʕtaṣabū) /iʕ.ta.sˤa.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَصَبَ (iʕtaṣaba)
# اِعْتَصِبُوا (iʕtaṣibū) /iʕ.ta.sˤi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْتَصَبَ (iʕtaṣaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
